video_title: Manusia Belum Tergantikan AI Karena Satu Hambatan Ini
comment: Ada constraint lain selain energi pak, yaitu efficient compute frontier. Dari seluruh LLM atau AI model semua gak bisa melewati barrier ini seberapapun canggihnya mereka, karena yg terjadi saat terbentur barier ini, kenaikan inteligensi AI menjadi tidak sebanding dengan sumberdaya yang perlu dikeluarkan (diminishing returns). Hingga saat ini penelitian terdepan pun belum bisa menjawab kenapa barrier ini terjadi. salah satu alasannya mungkin karena AI atau LLM prinsip kerjanya memprediksi kata berdasarkan pola statistik dari datasize yang sangat besar. Dalam statistik selalu ada error tipe I (alfa) dan error tipe II (beta), dan kedua error ini gak mungkin mencapai 0%. Jd AI bisa banyak mengantikan manusia dalam posisi tertentu, tp mustahil AI bs menggantikan manusia seperti cerita atau film2 futuristik, karena seberapapun canggih AI, mereka akan terbentur tembok tidak kasat mata yg bernama efficient frontier barrier, jd saat AI udah di peak, butuh sumberdaya yang terlalu besar untuk naikin 1 point intelegensi nya, sehingga kenaikan tersebut jd gak worth. Kita manusia kan penuh keterbatasan, sekarang aja open AI kan lg tersangkut kasus hukum karena mrk pengen go public untuk memperoleh dana dari investor lain untuk pengembangan AI yang lebih canggih, tp seberapapun kekayaan diseluruh dunia di fokuskan untuk pengembangan AI, manusia akan terbentur lg dgn keterbatasan sumber daya, sehingga constraint AI seperti lingkaran setan yg cuma muter2 aja, dan AI akan mencapai titik peak nya. Mungkin ini cara Tuhan membuat kita rendah hati bahwa kita tidak akan mampu mengalahkan ciptaan-Nya. Anyway, ya tugas qt ya belajar menggunakan AI sbg alat untuk mempermudah kita mengerjakan pekerjaan kita. Sehingga kita, manusia yg menentukan alat yg powerful tersebut mau digunakan seperti apa, bukan sebaliknya, alat yg mendikte kita harus menggunakannya seperti apa. Ini yg aq lihat dari beberapa pengguna AI di sekitar ku, mrk terlalu percaya AI sehingga mengurangi kebiasaan berpikir kritis. Simpelnya, pada akhirnya AI tetaplah AI, cabut stop kontak nya, mati smua. Yang jd ketakutan ku dan peneliti AI yg resign dr chat GPT dan antropic claude adalah krn perkembangannya terlalu pesat (pengusaha yg mengembangkan AI cm ingin ngeruk dana investor yg saat ini lg honeymoon dgn AI) tp hingga saat ini belum ada pihak yg seharusnya membuat regulasi terkait penggunaan AI secara etis

video_title: Manusia Belum Tergantikan AI Karena Satu Hambatan Ini
comment: Kalo menggantikan manusia sepenuhnya, saya rasa tidak. Selain constraint energi, AI pada dasarnya butuh sensor dan motor untuk bisa berinteraksi secara fisik, ya karena kita hidup di dunia fisik. Robot pengantar pesanan canggih di china saja masih gagal mengenali kontur lintasan, kadang terjebak pada lubang jalan, bahkan jurang. Untuk mengatasi hal tersebut, robot pada akhirnya memerlukan sistem sensor tambahan yang menambah kompleksitas dan point of failure. Sensor sendiri juga membutuhkan maintenance dari debu dan kerusakan fisik dimana hal tersebut tidak bisa dilakukan sendiri oleh robot. Bagaimana dengan menggabungkan semua saluran CCTV untuk penginderaan secara online dan real-time? Tetap saja CCTV punya resolusi terbatas, dan tidak semua area ter-cover dengan CCTV. Selain itu robot juga tidak punya kemampuan self repair. Menambahkan mekanisme self repair akan hanya menambah lagi point of failure dan tidak efisien. Jadi saya sebut ini sebagai constraint physics. Dari sisi sumber daya, penggunaan robot membutuhkan material rare earth element untuk sensor dan chip, jika saat ini saja, produksi RAM masih belum cukup untuk memenuhi kebutuhan AI, lalu bagaimana jika ditambah dengan komponen utama robot seperti sensor dan mikrokontroler? Belum lagi masalah replacement komponen yang rusak. Hal ini menuntut lebih banyak pembangunan pabrik semikonduktor yang membutuhkan modal besar dan waktu yang lama untuk memenuhi kebutuhan pasar. Jadi saya sebut ini constraint resources. Selama masalah di atas tidak bisa ditangani sendiri oleh super intelligence, maka tetap ada ketergantungan dengan manusia untuk menjaga ekosistem AI tetap berjalan. Jadi apakah 2030 AI menggantikan seluruh manusia? Saya masih pesimistis

comment: capitalism is a system of free trade. Nothing more, nothing less. In order to make capitalism, you need a system of governments that is exclusively in charge of protecting the rights of citizens. That is not the case in any country and the debate is regarding rights. The rich get richer but the poor also get richer. Everyone gets richer. That's the whole point. And it's not mindless production. It's a matter of supply and demand. If nobody wants plastic, nobody will make plastic. If nobody wants social media, you won't have social media. If nobody wants cars, there will be no new cars made. It's not production for the sake of production. It's a matter of adhering to values. Yes, the rich get richer. But in a free system, you could get a loan from a bank and create something new and become the rich yourself if you have something better than the rich people. In capitalism, being rich only means you have faster access to resources. It doesn't mean you have power. You are just faster. If a rich person and a poor person have the same idea for a product or a service, the rich person will make it first because they have faster access to resources in order to create. And usually people get rich by making something other people benefit from. Not inheritance. Inheritance is usually lost when the person who got the money is a worthless human being who has nothing to contribute to society (which results in the money going to other places anyway). Capitalism is a system of free trade. What you see in the world with the "too big to fail" corporations is because there is not enough capitalism. You can get favors from the government. You have regulations. You have subsidies. You have taxes. That's called cronyism. Not capitalism. And it is still miles better than anything else we currently have (could be much better but hat's not the point). If the rich get richer, why does that matter? The world is not a zero sum game. When the rich get richer it's not because everybody else gets poorer. If that was the case, then we would still have the same situation as we had 100 years ago where wealth stayed the same. The rich get richer faster. But the poor also get richer. Being a poor person in a first world country today is a lot better than being a fairly well off person 200 years ago. That's because wealth has increased. The overall sum of has been increased. I recommend you study Austrian Economy (not the country) in order to understand how trade works on a fundamental level and why anti-capitalists are fking idiots when they use "the rich get richer" as if that's even a valid argument.

The data over the last decade says that AI does... not... take... jobs. Even though this time may have really felt different, it wasn't different. And no, the AI boom marked by the release of ChatGPT and its cohort doesn't change the conclusion. That boom is ~2 years old now. The unemployment rate is flat, and the LFPR is increasing. If AI has automated jobs away in the last 2 years without replacing them, then it hasn't shown up in the data. I love Grey's work, but this video was a miss. The numbers here just don't match up with the story. Regardless of how much it seems like the AI takeover is iminent... Regarless of how compelling analogies about horses are... Regardless of how remarkable and powerful AI is... Regardless of how big of an effect AI and automation has had and will continue to have on civilization... The data is simply undeniable: The advance of automation has not (and is not) reducing the number of jobs available for humans to do. Humans very much need to apply.

comment: "And probably yes, computers will be able to think deeper and more far than us" They won't, though. This is some popular science-fiction vs. real-life science stuff. Computers are limited, not by processing power (computations over time) but by their physical architecture. Computers are faster than human brains, but they're also much more simple. This cannot change by simply adding more hardware to a computer, which is how we increase their computational power at any given time. Nor can it be changed by evolving computer language, because it is still bound by its hardware's architecture. Computers seem impressive. And they seem to be getting more impressive. But they're still within the limits of what it is to be a Turing machine. There are still problems they cannot solve, and will never be able to solve no matter how much we polish them. It will require the invention of a completely new system, above and beyond our computers and with little resemblance to them, to achieve just the equivalent of a human mind. People tend to conflate computational speed with the actual complexity of the machine. But just because a race car gets faster and faster every year, you don't assume it's suddenly going to turn into a rocket and take you to Mars. This is how silly it is to assume a computer will suddenly become a reasoning intelligence.
